scope: research/aps_leads_20261105 identity records only; mathematical chart lifting and frontier-set interpretation remain conditional producer derivations
statement: The APS lead identity wrapper compiled against the unchanged native identity_certificate and SHA-256 modules, then issued and producer-replayed IDC1h9e131e5cd24a395f and IDC1ha14548fc2b5ce5c3 with 32 certificate points and 32 extra producer points each over 2^61-1. For each, adding 1 to the RHS was refused and changing its digest was refused. This is an unverified producer assertion about identity-record validation, not independent verification, a chart-completeness proof, an APS correctness/performance experiment or a speedup.
